conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because wdata_i is held and exposed in dbus_req_o.data through lines 94, 100, and 103. considered, not kept.reason: The request, direction, write-enable, and access-size fields of ctrl_i are access command fields whose information is part of the access rather than a separate conceptual asset.
The instruction fields and amo_cmd only select the atomic operation and its result form, so the operation-selector rule bars a separate concept.
dbus_rsp_i.ack, dbus_req_o.stb, and wait_o only time or acknowledge the forwarded transaction and are barred as handshake information of their own.
ctrl_i.cpu_trap is a processor context field tested only to clear pending, so it is part of that decision rather than a separate piece of information.
clk_i and rstn_i are clock and reset inputs, while the clocked state only sequences the memory transfer, so the clocks, reset, and pacing behavior are barred as conceptual assets.
